title: A Federated Label Anchoring Method for Fault Diagnosis of Rotating Machinery with Data Privacy
note: FL (federated learning for distributed training across industrial clients) + PdM (fault diagnosis of rotating machinery and nuclear power pump systems). LLM used only for label embedding generation, not as FM for time-series. Covers FL + PdM clearly.

title: Federated Learning With Client Clustering Selection and Quality-Aware Model Aggregation (2024)
note: FL (core focus on FL framework for IIoT) + FM (explicitly mentions foundation models like ChatGPT in IIoT context) + PdM (mentions predictive maintenance, production optimization in IIoT). However, tested on FMNIST/CIFAR-10, not industrial data. Foundation models mentioned but not central to contribution.

title: Towards artificial intelligence-enabled autonomous battery prognostics and management
note: MAYBE: PdM is clear (SOH estimation, RUL prediction, battery health management). Mentions FL and FM in survey context but these are among many AI techniques discussed, not core contribution. No time-series foundation model applied.

title: AI-Driven Log Analysis: Advances and Challenges
note: MAYBE: Core is log anomaly detection and RCA for IT systems (not industrial PdM). FL and LLMs mentioned only in future research directions section. Tangentially related to industrial monitoring.

title: The role of large language models (LLMs) in enhancing intelligent transportation systems: A survey
note: MAYBE: Survey on LLMs in ITS. Mentions predictive maintenance as one application among many (traffic optimization, V2X, etc.). FL mentioned as methodology. Related to industrial systems but transportation-focused.

title: Artificial intelligence and machine learning for smart grids: from foundational paradigms to emerging technologies with digital twin and large language model-driven intelligence
note: MAYBE: Comprehensive survey covering FL, FM (LLMs), and predictive maintenance for smart grids. PdM is one of many applications discussed. Broad survey rather than focused contribution.

title: Integration of Foundation Models and Federated Learning in AIoT-Based Aircraft Health Monitoring Systems
note: MAYBE: FL+FM applied to aircraft fleet health monitoring (PdM domain). Strong overlap but aviation-focused, not manufacturing. FM and FL are core but industrial PdM is secondary.
